stories.title: Mahindra XEV 9S scores 5 stars in Bharat NCAP crash test
stories.summary: The Mahindra XEV 9S secured a five-star rating in Bharat NCAP crash tests, scoring 31.15 out of 32 for Adult Occupant Protection. The rating covers all variants across six- and seven-seat configurations and various battery options. The vehicle was assessed in July 2026.

stories.summary: VinFast has revealed a facelifted VF5 with a larger 43kWh battery and a 370-kilometre range. The compact electric SUV now features a more aggressive design. While the company has not confirmed India-specific details, the model is currently undergoing road tests in the country.

stories.title: Hyundai considers bringing Genesis brand to India
stories.summary: Hyundai is reportedly planning to introduce its luxury brand, Genesis, to the Indian market by 2027. The company has filed a patent for the GV90, signaling a potential move upmarket. Hyundai currently maintains a strong position in India through its mass-market vehicle lineup.

stories.title: Production-ready Hyundai Neira EV MPV revealed
stories.summary: Hyundai has unveiled the production-ready Neira EV MPV ahead of its 20 November debut. The vehicle shares features and specifications with the Kia Carens Clavis EV. Design elements from the prototype remain unchanged, though the interior details have not yet been officially disclosed.

stories.title: Kia Sorento crosses 4,500 dispatches since September
stories.summary: Kia has dispatched 4,500 units of the Sorento SUV in India since bookings opened in September 2026. Priced from Rs 27.99 lakh, the vehicle offers hybrid options and all-wheel drive. These figures represent wholesale dispatches to dealers rather than final customer deliveries.

stories.title: Ducati Desmo450 EDX launched in India at Rs 18.55 lakh
stories.summary: Ducati has launched the Desmo450 EDX and the 2027 Desmo450 MX Factory in India, priced at Rs 18.55 lakh and Rs 21.26 lakh respectively. Both models share a 449.6cc engine, though the EDX is configured for enduro use while the MX Factory is built for motocross.

stories.title: Ampere EV sales surpass full-year FY26 volumes
stories.summary: Ampere recorded 70,333 electric two-wheeler registrations between April and 15 November 2026, exceeding the 61,842 units sold during the entire FY26. The brand reported a 93 percent year-on-year growth, securing the fifth position in the Indian electric two-wheeler market.

Trading volume reached 48 lakh shares, approximately three times the daily average. The stock previously hit a 52-week high of ₹272 in July.

stories.title: Ampere reaches top 5 in electric two-wheeler sales
stories.summary: Ampere has surpassed its total FY26 sales volume within the first seven months of FY27, recording 70,333 registrations as of 15 November 2026. The company now holds a 5.7 percent market share, marking a 93 percent annual growth rate compared to the previous year.

stories.title: Bajaj Pulsar 180 discontinued again
stories.summary: Bajaj has removed the Pulsar 180 from its official website, marking the second time the model has been discontinued in five years. The motorcycle was relaunched in April 2026 but failed to maintain its place in the lineup alongside the Pulsar 125, 150, and 220F.

stories.title: Updated Bajaj Pulsar RS200 test mule spotted
stories.summary: A test mule of the updated Bajaj Pulsar RS200 has been spotted featuring a new digital cluster and USD forks. These updates align with recent changes made to the Pulsar NS200. The lack of camouflage on the test vehicle suggests a launch in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Royal Enfield to launch five new motorcycles
stories.summary: Royal Enfield plans to launch five new motorcycles in India starting this month. The lineup includes the Himalayan 750, which is expected to debut at the Motoverse 2026 event in Goa between 27 and 29 November. The company has been expanding its range following recent unveilings at EICMA.

stories.title: Jharkhand plans 500 EV charging stations
stories.summary: The Jharkhand transport department has proposed installing 500 electric vehicle charging stations across the state. The plan aims to place a charging point every 20 kilometres along the road network. State EV sales grew by 56 percent year-on-year in June 2026.

stories.title: Canton opens two public electric vehicle charging stations
stories.summary: Canton has opened two public charging stations at Mills Pond Park and River Road, providing four total charging spots for residents. The town is charging 40 cents per kWh for the service. The infrastructure is now available for public use.

India electric mobility study shows high consumer interest
stories.summary: A BearingPoint study of 10,000 drivers across five countries suggests 39 percent of Indian urban consumers likely to buy a vehicle within three years prefer a battery electric model. BEVs accounted for 8 percent of new registrations by September. Intentions are running ahead of current market development.

stories.title: Uber to launch 5,000 electric rickshaws in India
stories.summary: Uber plans to deploy 5,000 electric three-wheeled rickshaws across India over the next 12 months. The company has partnered with Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited to provide financial assistance for drivers transitioning from CNG vehicles. The initiative aims to address rising fuel costs and urban pollution.

stories.title: Delhivery to add 2,000 electric light commercial vehicles
stories.summary: Logistics firm Delhivery has signed agreements to acquire up to 2,000 electric light commercial vehicles from Tata Motors, Euler Motors, and Montra Electric. The company intends to source the Intra EV Pickup from Tata, which features a 1,750 kg payload capacity and a 72 kW motor.

stories.title: Portugal plans electric vehicle subsidies for vulnerable families
stories.summary: Portugal plans to subsidize the purchase of over 20,000 electric vehicles for vulnerable families and microenterprises. The government intends to cover up to 80 percent of vehicle costs, capped at 15,000 euros. The policy aims to increase sustainability while navigating concerns regarding private car reliance and EU-wide competition.

This represents a tenfold increase from the current half-million milestone. The council suggests the current sales boom requires stronger government policy and improved charging access to remain viable.

stories.title: Tata Motors secures over 3,400 electric commercial vehicle orders
stories.summary: Tata Motors shares rose 2 percent after the company announced orders for over 3,400 electric commercial vehicles. The backlog includes 2,000 small commercial vehicles and pick-ups, 900 trucks, and 500 buses. The firm is also participating in a government scheme to replace older vehicles in the Delhi-NCR region.

stories.title: M&H Carriers adds 18 eSprinters to Scottish fleet
stories.summary: Scottish distribution firm M&H Carriers has added 18 Mercedes-Benz eSprinters to its 325-vehicle fleet. The company previously limited electric vehicle adoption due to high costs and range constraints. These new vans provide 125 miles of additional range compared to the firm's earlier electric models.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland reports healthy volume despite margin pressure
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported strong revenue growth for the second quarter of 2026-27, driven by robust commercial vehicle demand. Higher input costs have weighed on margins, though analysts expect healthy volumes to continue through the 2028 fiscal year. The company is currently managing cost inflation.

stories.summary: M&H Carriers has acquired 18 Mercedes-Benz eSprinters to expand its electric delivery operations in northern Scotland. The company, which operates 325 vehicles, says the new vans offer 125 miles of additional range. Previous electric fleet expansion had been restricted by vehicle costs and limited driving range.

stories.title: M&H Carriers invests in electric van fleet expansion
stories.summary: M&H Carriers has purchased 18 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vans, citing a need for improved range and cost-efficiency. The drop was attributed to lower Kharif sowing and a shift in the festive calendar. Manufacturers are now citing deficient monsoon rainfall as a concern for future demand.

stories.summary: Collins Aerospace, a unit of RTX, is establishing a propeller repair facility in Bengaluru to target the global aircraft maintenance market. stories.summary: Richmond Street Automotive is advising drivers to check tread depth and uneven wear before winter. Technicians must now manage software-driven systems, ADAS calibration and EV architecture, often while relying on manual job notes. The industry is adapting to change, though some processes remain firmly in a different era.

stories.title: Citigroup keeps Penske Automotive at neutral
stories.summary: Citigroup maintained a neutral rating on Penske Automotive Group while raising its price target to $212 from $210. The adjustment represents a 1 percent increase and aligns with the stock's closing price on November 16. Analysts continue to track the company's performance in the current market.

stories.title: Penske Automotive faces profitability headwinds
stories.summary: Penske Automotive Group is grappling with declining vehicle margins, rising operating expenses and a growing debt burden. Regulatory shifts in the U.K. and evolving EV market dynamics are further complicating the company's financial outlook. Inventory levels are rising as the firm attempts to manage its current debt load.

stories.title: Gold loan lenders seek regulatory relief
stories.summary: Gold-loan-focused non-banking financial companies have formed a federation to petition the Reserve Bank of India for easier capital requirements. The group aims to act as a self-regulatory organization following revised central bank rules that have raised concerns about asset quality and risk-weight norms across the sector.

stories.title: Accessing free credit reports in India
stories.summary: Individuals in India are entitled to one free credit report annually from each of the four registered credit information companies. The Reserve Bank of India mandate allows consumers to monitor their credit history and scores without paying subscription fees to TransUnion CIBIL, Experian, Equifax or CRIF High Mark.

stories.title: Domestic auto stocks face demand and cost pressures
stories.summary: The domestic auto industry is contending with record vehicle prices, high financing costs and weakening consumer confidence. While EV sales have shown recovery, the expiration of federal tax credits creates uncertainty. Automakers are currently balancing margin protection against the need for competitive pricing in a difficult market.

stories.title: Gold loans grow among new credit users
stories.summary: Gold loans accounted for nearly 25 percent of new-to-credit accounts in the September quarter, up from 16 percent a year prior. Retail credit in India grew 19 percent to 185.2 lakh crore, with gold and property loans driving the expansion in the broader credit landscape.

stories.title: BMW plans Alpina launch in India
stories.summary: BMW intends to introduce its ultra-luxury Alpina brand to India in 2027. The company plans to establish a standalone retail network across 10 cities to compete in the high-end luxury segment. BMW is currently recruiting staff to develop its local strategy and identify potential dealership partners.

stories.title: Analysts maintain hold rating on Rivian
stories.summary: Citi analyst Michael Ward maintained a hold rating on Rivian Automotive with a price target of $14.50. The company's shares closed at $12.18 last Friday. Analysts continue to provide coverage on consumer cyclical companies as they weigh the firm's current market position against its recent performance.

Retail credit in India expands by 19 percent
stories.summary: India's retail credit portfolio reached 185.2 trillion rupees in the September quarter, an 18.8 percent year-on-year increase. While housing loans remain the largest segment, gold loans and secured business lending recorded the fastest growth rates. The market continues to expand despite emerging concerns regarding loan repayment risks.

stories.title: Gold loans lead retail credit growth in India
stories.summary: India's retail credit portfolio grew 18.8 percent to 185.2 lakh crore by September 2026. Gold loans surged 60.6 percent, outpacing other segments as the fastest-growing category. While lending volume increased, rising loan delinquencies have begun to signal potential repayment risks for the broader financial sector.

stories.title: Auto sector expected to meet growth targets
stories.summary: The auto sector is on track to hit its 11 percent growth target for the 2026-27 financial year, according to Elara Capital. Resilient festive demand and manageable dealer inventory levels are supporting the outlook. Analysts continue to favor passenger vehicle and two-wheeler manufacturers over commercial vehicle segments.

stories.title: Power challenges persist in single pair ethernet
stories.summary: Single Pair Ethernet is intended to enable long-reach communication for industrial and automotive devices. However, power delivery remains a significant hurdle when applying existing IEEE standards beyond their original design intent. The technology is transforming connectivity, provided engineers can successfully manage the practical limitations of the hardware.

The hardware is now sampling for automotive manufacturers.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics lands first non-automotive Atlas trial
stories.summary: GlobalFoundries will become the first customer outside the automotive industry to test the Boston Dynamics Atlas humanoid. Testing is scheduled for early 2027. The semiconductor manufacturer already uses the company's Spot quadruped, which has traveled nearly 900 km at its Singapore facility since April 2026.

stories.title: Volvo increases lobbying on connected vehicle security
stories.summary: Volvo Car Corp. reported $500,000 in lobbying expenditures for the third quarter of 2026, focusing on the Connected Vehicle Security Act. The proposed legislation would restrict vehicles associated with China, Russia, Iran, or North Korea. The spending is up from $365,000 in the same period last year.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz expands hands-free driving features
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz is rolling out new MB.DRIVE features including Hands-free Assist and Proactive Lane Change Assist. The company says the technology is designed to make motorway journeys more comfortable and support drivers from start to destination. Availability will expand across its vehicle lineup through 2027.

Qualcomm targets $40 billion in non-handset revenue
stories.summary: Qualcomm is aiming for $40 billion in annual revenue from non-handset businesses by 2029. The company says its automotive cockpit chips are logging genuine design wins, with the automotive segment alone carrying a $10 billion revenue guidance target. The strategy relies on shifting away from mobile phones.

The 104.5 million euro plan aims to support 20,000 purchases. The measure remains subject to final approval from the European Commission before it can be implemented.

stories.title: Automakers seek to avoid EU-UK electric vehicle tariffs
stories.summary: European and UK automotive manufacturers are urging leaders to prevent a potential 1.8 billion euro tariff bill in 2027. The industry groups ACEA and SMMT warn that current trade policies threaten an 80 billion euro annual relationship. They are seeking a deal at this week's summit.

stories.title: Industry groups warn of trade barriers ahead of EU-UK summit
stories.summary: The European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association and the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders are calling for a joint statement to resolve trade disputes. They warn that new barriers could damage competitiveness in an 80 billion euro annual market. Tariffs are currently set to begin in six weeks.

stories.title: EU-UK electric vehicle trade faces tariff threat
stories.summary: Electric vehicles traded between the EU and UK could face 1.8 billion euros in tariffs in 2027 under stricter rules of origin in the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement. Automakers warn the new requirements will take effect soon. The trade deal is currently being re-evaluated by the industry.

stories.title: Airlines seek clarity on green fuel mandates
stories.summary: Airlines are requesting legal guidance on India's draft sustainable aviation fuel policy, which proposes blending mandates starting at 1 percent in 2027. Carriers are concerned about fuel premiums, compliance penalties, and liability if supplies fall short. The policy also requires airlines to uplift most fuel at Indian airports.

stories.title: Louis Vuitton reveals Las Vegas Grand Prix trophy trunk
stories.summary: Louis Vuitton has unveiled a custom trophy trunk for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, featuring Monogram canvas and white gold leaf stripes. The design includes a new Victory patch inspired by vintage travel stickers. It will be used to house the trophy for the race held in November.

stories.title: Valvoline and Mahindra extend Formula E partnership
stories.summary: Valvoline and Mahindra Racing have renewed their partnership for the Gen4 era of Formula E. The collaboration focuses on the co-development of e-fluids and transmission technologies. Mahindra enters the new season following its strongest performance to date, having secured a third-place finish in the 2025-26 championship.

stories.title: Fernando Alonso to drive for Aston Martin at Dakar
stories.summary: Fernando Alonso will compete in the 2027 Dakar Rally driving an Aston Martin Dreadnought. The two-time Le Mans winner joins teammates Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes for the event in Morocco and Portugal. Alonso previously finished 13th in the rally during his 2020 debut with Toyota.

stories.title: Aston Martin enters Dakar Rally with virtual concept
stories.summary: Aston Martin will debut at the 2027 Dakar Rally with three competition versions of the Dreadnought, a vehicle originally designed as a virtual concept for a video game. The team has recruited Fernando Alonso, Sebastien Loeb, and Lucas Moraes for the event held in Portugal and Morocco.

stories.title: Mahindra Racing debuts M13Electro for Gen4 era
stories.summary: Mahindra Racing has unveiled the M13Electro, its challenger for the 2027 Formula E season. The car marks the team's entry into the Gen4 era of the all-electric series. The organization aims to translate the new vehicle's technological potential into improved performance on the track.

Global electric vehicle sales continue to rise
stories.summary: Global electric vehicle sales exceeded 17 million in 2024, representing over 20 percent of new car purchases. Projections suggest this could reach 40 percent by 2030. While the transition is accelerating, adoption rates remain uneven across different regions, with Asia currently leading the global shift in mobility.

stories.title: Audi establishes subsidiary focused on automotive recycled plastics - Plastics News
Earthshot Prize chair frames green shift as economic
stories.summary: Jesper Brodin, chair of the Earthshot Prize, stated that cutting emissions is a future-driven economic necessity rather than a political choice. The prize, established by Prince William, awards 1 million pounds to environmental solutions. Brodin noted that businesses can improve their emissions performance regardless of the current political climate.

stories.title: Harvard study links data centers to high emissions
stories.summary: A Harvard University study found that the 400 largest US data centers produce more heat-trapping gas than the entire nation of Denmark. Meanwhile, COP31 negotiators have launched a voluntary pledge for countries to power data centers with clean energy and increase transparency regarding their power and water consumption.

stories.title: German automakers lose market share in China
stories.summary: Combined sales of Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW in China fell by nearly a third between 2019 and 2025. Local brands now hold 65.3 percent of the market. Volkswagen reported net losses of 5.8 billion euros in the third quarter as the industry shifts toward electric vehicles.

stories.title: GM hires search firm to find successor to CEO Mary Barra, report says - Automotive News
Nissan debuts plug-in hybrid to recover China sales
stories.summary: Nissan is launching the NX7 plug-in hybrid SUV in China to rebuild its market share. The move follows a general decline in sales for Japanese automakers in the country. Preorders for the new model began on 13 November as the company attempts to revamp its local strategy.

stories.title: Chinese Electric Vehicles: What Canadians Really Want - Collision Repair Mag
Canada auto industry warns of Chinese kit cars
stories.summary: The Canadian Vehicle Manufacturers Association is raising concerns that potential trade talks with Beijing could allow Chinese kit cars into the domestic market. The industry warns that importing parts for cheap assembly could negatively impact local jobs. China currently uses kit exports to boost its global automotive presence.

stories.title: GM president says he is not afraid of Chinese cars
stories.summary: General Motors President Mark Reuss says he is not afraid of Chinese cars, though he takes the industry very seriously. China exported over 8 million passenger vehicles in the first 10 months of 2026. Reuss plans to counter this by pointing to the durability of Detroit factories.

stories.title: Canadians polled on Chinese investment in EV manufacturing
stories.summary: An Angus Reid poll found 59 percent of Canadians would allow Chinese investment in domestic electric vehicle and battery manufacturing. However, 46 percent of respondents want additional security or ownership restrictions placed on such deals. The survey was conducted with the Centre for Strategic Statecraft.

stories.title: Tesla ends 13-month sales decline in Europe
stories.summary: Tesla has recorded its first year-over-year increase in European registrations in 13 months. The company sold 13,740 cars in the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the European Free Trade Association last month. The broader European electric vehicle market grew by 15.8 percent during the same period.

stories.title: JLR to add electric Defender to lineup in 2027
stories.summary: JLR will launch a battery-electric Defender in 2027 to be sold alongside the existing gasoline model. CEO P.B. Balaji confirmed the vehicle will be built at the Halewood plant as the second model based on the company's Electrified Modular Architecture. It will not replace the current version.

BYD cumulative sales in Japan exceed 10,000
stories.summary: Chinese automaker BYD has sold more than 10,000 passenger cars in Japan since January 2023. The company reached its first 5,000 sales in two and a half years, while the next 5,000 took 15 months. Growth is attributed to the Racco electric kei car.

stories.title: BYD gains traction in Japan with Racco model
stories.summary: BYD has surpassed 10,000 cumulative sales in Japan, a market traditionally dominated by domestic brands. The Racco electric kei car recorded 607 sales in October, trailing the Nissan Sakura. BYD offers higher range for a lower sticker price, though subsidies can make the local competitor cheaper.
